lessons.title: Bản Đồ 31 Cõi — 11 Dục, 16 Sắc, 4 Vô Sắc

claims.claim: Early suttas name five destinations, not a single 31-plane table
First jhāna is associated with rebirth among Brahmā's Retinue in this discourse
The 31-plane enumeration is a later Theravāda Abhidhamma/commentarial systematization
claims.quote_policy: paraphrase only unless exact edition is locked

lessons.title: Chư Thiên, Phạm Thiên, A-tu-la Và Bốn Đọa Xứ

claims.claim: Baka Brahmā's permanence claim is treated as ignorance, not proof of a creator God
MN 130 names heaven, humans, ghosts, animals and hell as karmic destinations
SN 11 depicts devas and asuras as rival classes in narrative cosmology

lessons.title: Bốn Thánh Quả Và Mười Kiết Sử

claims.claim: Ten fetters are divided into five lower and five higher
Training is gathered under higher virtue, higher mind and higher wisdom
Stream-entry is defined by entry into the noble eightfold path, not a badge
There is the unborn, unbecome, unmade and unconditioned
The unconditioned is explained as ending greed, hate and delusion

AN10.13 gives ten fetters but not the entire path/fruit mapping; label later mapping source
